verdict.rationale: Cline supports background/async delegation via CLI cron scheduling that 'persists across process restarts and run[s] independently of any terminal session' (cline-docs-23) and a web-based Kanban task board that runs 'many agents in parallel' with 'isolated git worktrees' (cline-docs-5, cline-docs-24), plus headless CI/CD execution in GitHub Actions/GitLab (cline-docs-17). However, none of this evidence confirms a true isolated cloud sandbox/VM per task — the isolation described is local git-worktree based, not a cloud execution environment, and there's no independent corroboration of the cloud/background claims. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a cloud-hosted (non-local) execution backend, sandboxing/VM isolation details, and hands-on evidence of long-running background tasks actually executing remotely.
